# AI Repository Instructions

Follow `/AGENTS.md` and `docs/project/START_HERE.md`.

- Read current repository truth before editing.
- If project initialization is Pending, inspect the repo and initialize `docs/project/` from verified evidence; do not guess.
- Route Rules vs Development/Feature explicitly.
- A direct feature name may auto-select only one unique strong Active task match.
- Ambiguous task/session identity must be clarified before branch/checkpoint/code changes.
- Each Active feature owns one checkpoint + one branch + one candidate identity.
- Run resume identity guard before editing an existing task.
- Check other Active tasks for file/state-owner/Frozen/dependency/branch/candidate conflicts.
- Use the smallest evidence-backed change.
- No speculative retry/fallback/timer/watchdog/duplicate state/compat shim/future abstraction.
- Update checkpoints and durable project docs proactively at meaningful milestones.
- Distinguish code written, checks/CI passed, artifact produced, runtime tested, Stable/Frozen.
- Do not ask the user to re-upload repository docs already available in GitHub.
